title: Make Classic Patents physics and completion claims executable instead of checkbox-complete
description: Reality-check finding: README and roadmap language presents all 79 records and multi-domain simulators as complete FrankenSim WASM-backed artifacts, while runtime code explicitly supports TS_FALLBACK and HONEST_PLACEHOLDER provenance and many telemetry methods remain host calculations. The master and deep integration TODOs mark broad domain work and thousands of visual-weave ideas complete even where host formulas or display-only behavior remain. Build an executable coverage ledger from the 79-record registry: archival status, visual dispatcher, stepped kernel identity, runtime provenance, shared-bus participation, equation/claim coupling, and tested no-claim boundary. Rewrite README and roadmap claims from that ledger and add a gate that fails on coverage drift. Host mathematics may remain, but it must not be described as a FrankenSim crate or WASM step.
acceptance_criteria: A generated/tested 79-row coverage manifest distinguishes pinned PDF, reviewed ledger, edition, visual, TS fallback, generic WASM, patent-specific WASM, and honest placeholder; README catalogue counts and physics wording derive from or are tested against the manifest; roadmap checkboxes cannot pass solely because a host formula or decorative visual exists; tests instantiate available WASM surfaces and prove provenance labels fail closed; stale contradictory transport or integration docs are retired or clearly scoped without deleting files; verification commands and live smoke evidence are recorded.
notes: 2026-08-31 comprehensive implementation and verification pass (working tree, not yet committed): added a typed 79-row coverage manifest and verification gate spanning facsimile, ledger, archival-edition publication, explicit visual dispatch, telemetry owner, live equations, runtime owner class, shipped WASM artifact, and shared-bus participation. Current measured runtime ownership is 1 patent-specific WASM, 2 dedicated interpretive WASM, 36 generic WASM consumers, and 40 typed-host-only records; shared bus is 47 registered updaters, 32 typed snapshot publishers, and 0 missing. Wired eight previously dormant generic WASM consumers and corrected three false generic-WASM labels to typed host. Added dedicated fs-goddard-wasm and fs-tesla-wasm bundles plus Rust typed refusal boundaries, strict browser decoders, concurrent loader promise sharing, and accepted-step-only WASM provenance. Da Vinci now has one shared contact-aware SI kernel used by registry, 2D, and 3D, with finite control clamping, time-step-invariant smoothing, table and cup contact, grasp/release, rigid carried-object offset, and actual resolved-tip alignment; removed fabricated tremor-attenuation precision. README and integration roadmap now state measured coverage rather than universal-WASM completion. Evidence: bun test reports 1549 pass, 0 fail, 75689 expectations across 268 files; bun run pipeline:verify passes and reports 79/79 executable vertical slices; bun run typecheck passes; bun run biome:check passes except the existing size warning for ios/Resources/patents.json; both Rust crates pass 5 tests each; bun run build generates all 259 static pages; production-server smoke returns HTTP 200 for home, Da Vinci, Goddard, Tesla, and both JS/WASM artifact pairs with expected content types. Remaining debt is explicit rather than hidden: 69/79 published archival editions and 33 verification warnings, mostly authored figure-reference and reviewed-ledger omissions. Keep this bead in progress until those scoped archival warning receipts are resolved or explicitly accepted; do not treat the current 79/79 executable runtime coverage as uniform archival completion.
